title: Swiggy Sibling Wars (Rakhi Special)
details: Swiggy Sibling Wars is an interactive, gamified Raksha Bandhan campaign on the Swiggy app where users pick sides, compete in mini-battles, and complete referral tasks to earn up to ₹200 in Swiggy Money / discount coupons for food and Instamart orders.
steps: Open the Swiggy mobile app and locate the Rakhi Sibling Wars banner on the homepage.
Click to enter the game and select your side: Team Bro or Team Sis.
Tap on the invite/share button to generate your unique referral link.
Share the link with friends; when they click your link and join a team, ₹10 is credited to both of your Swiggy wallets.
Repeat the process to earn up to the maximum cap of ₹200 in free cash.
Apply your earned Swiggy Cash at checkout during your next food or Instamart order.
